The '''Sarlacc Pit''' on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] existed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Third battle of Felucia]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] requested that a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] collect samples of green slime dripping off the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlaccs]] spines for medical technology.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sarlacc Pit first appeared in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] in the Felucia warzone. The 'Sarlacc Slime' quest requires the player to collect samples of green slime off the sarlacc's spines. If the player jumps into the sarlacc, they will mysteriously be bounced up out of the pit. This is a game mechanic so players do not have to die if they fall down into the pit.
